01 — Services

Everything your dog needs,
done properly.

Every groom is one-to-one with Vicki — bath, cut, nails and ears, finished with care. Prices depend on breed, size and coat, so call or email for a quote.

Service 01

Full Groom

Bath with gentle shampoo, blow-dry, full haircut to your chosen style, nails trimmed and ears cleaned. The complete pamper.

Service 02

Bath & Blow Dry

A warm bath, gentle blow-dry and brush-out — perfect between full grooms, or for short-coated dogs who just need freshening up.

Service 03

Puppy's First Groom

A slow, gentle first visit so your puppy learns grooming is a happy thing — a little bath, a little trim, lots of patience and praise.

Service 04

Nail Trim & Care

Nails checked and trimmed with care, ears cleaned, and a quick tidy of face, feet and hygiene areas. A fast refresh between grooms.

De-shedding Treatment

02 — Why Vicki

Fourteen years of happy dogs,
and owners who come back.

There is no big chain here and no rushing between dogs. It is one groomer, one dog, and all the time your dog needs.

01

14+ years of experience

Vicki has groomed dogs for over fourteen years — every breed, every coat, every temperament.

02

Fully insured

Your dog is in safe, insured hands from drop-off to pick-up. Peace of mind, every visit.

03

One-to-one, never rushed

Your dog is the only dog in the salon. No cages, no waiting around, no rushing — just calm, patient grooming.

04

Home-run & familiar

A warm home salon in Craigavon, not a noisy shop. Nervous dogs settle faster in a calm, familiar room.

Run by Vicki McClelland from her home in Craigavon — the same groomer, the same calm room, and the same care, every single visit.

03 — Booking

Booking is simple.
Three steps, that's it.

No apps, no accounts, no middlemen. Just call or email Vicki directly and your dog is booked in.

1

Call or email

Ring 07824 669551 or email barkinbeauty@googlemail.com. Tell Vicki your dog's breed and what you need — she will give you a quote and a time.

2

Drop off

Bring your dog to 67 Coharra Road, Craigavon. Vicki grooms one dog at a time, at your dog's own pace.

3

Pick up a happy dog

Collect a clean, beautifully groomed dog — and book the next visit before you leave, so your slot is safe.

Your dog's next groom is one call away.

Call or email today and Vicki will find you a time that suits you and your dog.
